function bindControls(c): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/arrows.ts:24

Wires every carousel control: prev/next clicks + hover (hover stops autoplay permanently — pointer over a control is intent to drive), dot clicks, and track scroll/swipe. Touch listeners are passive so scroll stays on the compositor thread — the handler only reads positions and never calls preventDefault.

c

CustomCarousel
